name: I Segye Misonyeo Gongnyakbeop!
source:
“…What did I even do in my past life to deserve this?”

After your professor ruins your future yet again, you fail to escape graduate school for another year.

You close your eyes for just a moment, and when you wake up...
you find yourself on a floating island in another world?!

“I finally found you…♡”

Summoned without warning, you suddenly become the center of attention for the alluring heroines.

Before you can even adjust, romance begins to bloom.

Meet a cast of captivating heroines:

Nixia, a shy succubus apprentice who believes you are her Destined One
“If you’d let me… I could kiss you right now…♡”

Hui, a black fox student council president hiding secrets behind her tails
“That’s against school rules. But… I’ll allow this romance just once.”

Sietta, an elf nun concealing a painful past behind her gentle smile
“When you look at me like that… my heart starts trembling like I’m in love.”

Miel, a silent dragon girl who always watches over you
“How long have I been watching you? …The entire time. Until you made your choice.”

As danger closes in on the floating island, your bonds deepen through romance, trust, desire, and love.

Will you stay in this world and continue your romantic journey with these beautiful girls?

Or will you abandon love and return to your original world?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.storytaco.c24client]Playstore[/url]]
